# joplin-md-sync

> Safe two-way synchronization between Joplin and a Markdown workspace, plus
> MCP and ChatGPT Actions interfaces for coding agents and AI assistants.

Canonical documentation: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/
Source: https://github.com/kogeler/joplin-md-sync

## Start here

- Overview: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/OVERVIEW/
- Installation: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/GETTING_STARTED/
- Agent workflows: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/AGENT_WORKFLOWS/
- Interface guide: https://joplin-mcp.romancello.net/AGENT_INTERFACES/

## Agent safety

- Pull before editing.
- Keep managed metadata headers intact.
- Review a three-way diff and `push --dry-run` before a real push.
- Do not edit `.joplin-sync/`.
- Do not interleave MCP writes with unpushed local edits.
- Do not expose the Joplin Data API to a network.
- Never put a Joplin, MCP, Actions, sync, or encryption token in chat, Git, or
  command arguments.
